record.dic_text:
01735 Dowdavahuw {do:-da:-va:'-hu:}

源自 01730 和 03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Dodavah 1; 1

多大瓦 = "耶和華所摯愛的"
1) 一位猶大地的瑪利沙人, 以利以謝的父親,
   以利以謝曾抨擊指責約沙法和亞哈謝交好結盟 (#代下 20:37|)
record.edic_text:
01735 Dowdavahuw {do-daw-vaw'-hoo}

from 01730 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Dodavah 1; 1

Dodavah = "beloved of Jehovah"
1) a man of Mareshah in Judah, the father of Eliezer, who denounced
   Jehoshaphat's alliance with Ahaziah
